status: Proposed next thirty-minute block; this file does not claim all twenty tests executed.
positive_contract: Four original exact labelled pairs, proper rigid transforms with unit scale, at most one original outlier, and a reliable additional observation with Euclidean error at most one. The 57-point pool is virtual until an acquisition-feasibility mask is supplied.
positive_controls: Recover all four original proper three-support hypotheses.
Recover the single off-axis five-pair four-support fit.
Check all six prediction distances and select (-1,-1,-1) with minimum squared separation eight when feasible.
Return both optimal six-pair registrations rather than identifying truth from their equal costs.

mutations.name: candidate_coverage
mutations.mutation: Drop one of the four exact feasible poses before scoring.
mutations.required_outcome: Reject the incomplete cover, even if the remaining pairwise gaps improve.

mutations.name: pair_coverage
mutations.mutation: Omit the closest of the six prediction pairs.
mutations.required_outcome: Reject the score certificate unless every unordered pair is checked.

mutations.name: model_binding
mutations.mutation: Replace fixed labelled correspondences with unknown matching on the regular tetrahedron.
mutations.required_outcome: Return twelve proper full-support poses rather than the fixed-label singleton.

mutations.name: orientation
mutations.mutation: Admit the determinant-minus-one reflection in the five-pair fixture.
mutations.required_outcome: Reject under SO(3); explicitly retain the extra fit under O(3).

mutations.name: scale_binding
mutations.mutation: Submit 2I as a rotation, or silently introduce an unknown positive scale.
mutations.required_outcome: Reject the nonorthogonal rotation; require a separate similarity model and full scale-domain certificate.

mutations.name: fault_budget
mutations.mutation: Add the fifth point but increase the allowed faults from one to two.
mutations.required_outcome: Retain the old three-support explanations; do not reuse the one-fault uniqueness claim.

mutations.name: acquisition_mask
mutations.mutation: Mark the unique best virtual point (-1,-1,-1) physically unavailable.
mutations.required_outcome: Choose a maximizer among feasible queries only, or abstain if none is informative.

mutations.name: empty_feasible_query_set
mutations.mutation: Remove every feasible acquisition.
mutations.required_outcome: Return no admissible query rather than inventing a feasible action.

mutations.name: noise_boundary
mutations.mutation: Use radius sqrt(2) at the best query and the midpoint of a closest prediction pair.
mutations.required_outcome: Retain both hypotheses because the two closed noise balls touch.

mutations.name: noise_inflation
mutations.mutation: Increase the new measurement radius beyond the declared value one.
mutations.required_outcome: Recompute separation; reject any old noise certificate whose margin is insufficient.

mutations.name: noisy_prior_cover
mutations.mutation: Perturb the original four exact observations and reuse exact triple enumeration.
mutations.required_outcome: Reject completeness: continuous feasible pose sets need certified enclosures.

mutations.name: query_target_binding
mutations.mutation: Replace the added target (0,0,2) by (10,0,2) in the seven-pair TLS fixture.
mutations.required_outcome: Invalidate the old identity certificate: identity costs four and the translated fit costs three.

mutations.name: threshold_binding
mutations.mutation: Change the six-pair TLS threshold from one to 15/2.
mutations.required_outcome: Reject lower bound three: the midpoint translation has cost 8/3.

mutations.name: units
mutations.mutation: Rescale coordinates without scaling the noise bound.
mutations.required_outcome: Reject the original model certificate or recompute it under the changed units.

mutations.name: duplicate_provenance
mutations.mutation: Reuse one acquisition ID as a supposedly new correspondence.
mutations.required_outcome: Do not count it as independent new support or a new fault-budget witness.

mutations.name: collinear_overlap
mutations.mutation: Use three collinear points as the supposedly identifying shared support.
mutations.required_outcome: Retain the rotation family about that line.

mutations.name: uninformative_query
mutations.mutation: Add the on-axis point (2,0,0) to the exact four-pair fixture.
mutations.required_outcome: Retain two proper four-support fits.

mutations.name: near_collinear_noise
mutations.mutation: Use sources 0,e1,(2,.01,0), targets 0,e1,(2,0,0), and radius .01.
mutations.required_outcome: Retain identity and the half-turn about the x axis; exact noncollinearity is insufficient.

mutations.name: clique_chirality
mutations.mutation: Supply the complete pair-distance graph of a reflected tetrahedron.
mutations.required_outcome: Reject the inference that a clique certifies an exact proper rigid fit.

mutations.name: tie_aware_output
mutations.mutation: Provide the two globally optimal six-pair registrations with identical objective value.
mutations.required_outcome: Return an ambiguity set or abstention; optimality alone must not select a true-world pose.
